name: Abyss
storyline:
You wake up at home with a splitting headache, only to discover that something isn’t quite right. A strange broadcast urges you to stay inside and avoid contact with the outside world. As tension builds, your surroundings begin to shift in unsettling ways, and your attempts to reach loved ones are met with unexpected obstacles.

What starts as a simple quest for answers soon reveals a layered psychological mystery. The house itself seems to resist your escape, locking you deeper into a mystery that blurs reality.
